Have you noticed any problems with your balance, dizziness, or difficulty walking? Also, how have your memory issues been affecting your daily life?

I haven’t had any problems with balance or dizziness, and I can still walk fine. But my memory isn’t what it used to be. I’ve been forgetting to pay bills, and my wife has had to take care of that for me now.

Do you have any family members who have been diagnosed with dementia or any other neurological conditions? Also, can you describe the tremor in more detail—does it occur at rest or only when you’re moving your hand?

Can you describe how your memory issues have affected your daily life? Have you noticed any changes in your ability to plan, organize, or follow conversations?
